title: Wooden Spoon Memecoin with Token-Weighted DAO Governance (ICP)

requirements.text: Implement a Motoko canister that provides a fungible memecoin token (“Wooden Spoon”) with core on-chain functionality: token metadata (name, symbol, decimals), total supply, per-principal balances, and transfer between principals.

quotes: can you create a memecoin on icp directly with the dao elements

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes query functions for token metadata, total supply, and balanceOf(principal).
Backend exposes an update function to transfer tokens from the caller to a recipient principal with amount validation (no negative/zero, sufficient balance).
Token balances persist across canister upgrades (stable state).

requirements.text: Add DAO governance to the same Motoko canister with token-weighted voting where each token equals one vote: proposal creation, proposal listing/detail, voting (yes/no/abstain), quorum/threshold rules, voting deadline, and proposal finalization/execution for at least one meaningful on-chain action.

quotes: with the dao elements. every token is a vote.

acceptanceCriteria: Backend supports creating a proposal with: title, description, creation time, voting end time, and an action payload (at minimum: a proposal to transfer tokens from a DAO treasury balance to a recipient).
Backend supports listing proposals and fetching a proposal by id, including current vote totals and status (active/accepted/rejected/executed/expired).
Voting weight is computed as the caller’s token balance at the time they vote; each principal can vote at most once per proposal.
Proposal transitions are enforced (cannot vote after end time; cannot execute unless accepted; cannot execute twice).
Quorum/threshold rules are implemented and documented in-code (e.g., minimum participation and yes-vote majority) and reflected in proposal status computation.
Governance state persists across upgrades (stable state).

requirements.text: Create a simple DAO treasury mechanism tied to the token: a dedicated treasury balance controlled by the canister, plus UI/logic to view treasury balance and to execute accepted “treasury transfer” proposals.

quotes: create a memecoin on icp directly with the dao elements

acceptanceCriteria: Backend maintains a treasury token balance owned/controlled by the canister and exposes a query to read it.
Accepted proposals of type “treasury transfer” can be executed on-chain, moving tokens from treasury to the specified recipient and marking the proposal executed.
Frontend displays treasury balance and allows executing an accepted, unexecuted proposal (only when conditions are met).

requirements.text: Build a React UI for the Wooden Spoon memecoin + DAO that works with Internet Identity: connect/disconnect, show the logged-in principal, show token balance, transfer tokens, and provide DAO screens to create proposals, browse proposals, vote, and execute accepted proposals.

quotes: make it the wooden spoon meme coin

acceptanceCriteria: App supports Internet Identity login and shows the active principal when connected.
User can view their token balance and perform a transfer to a principal + amount, with clear success/error states.
User can create a proposal (title, description, duration/end time, and treasury transfer parameters).
User can browse proposals, open a proposal detail view, cast a vote, and see updated vote totals/status.
UI prevents invalid actions (e.g., voting after deadline, voting twice, executing rejected/already executed proposals) and displays explanatory messaging.

requirements.text: Apply a coherent “Wooden Spoon” memecoin visual theme across the frontend (colors, typography, layout, and key components) inspired by playful DIY/wood textures and meme-coin energy, without using a blue/purple default palette.

quotes: make it the wooden spoon meme coin based on the iconic viceo

acceptanceCriteria: UI has a consistent theme (background, typography choices, button/input styling) and looks intentionally branded rather than default template styling.
Theme is applied consistently across wallet, token, and DAO screens.
User-facing text is in English and references the Wooden Spoon branding where appropriate (e.g., headings, labels).

requirements.text: Add generated static image assets for the Wooden Spoon memecoin branding and render them in the UI (stored under frontend/public/assets/generated).

quotes: wooden spoon meme coin based on the iconic viceo

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames.
Frontend references these images directly as static assets (not fetched from the backend).
At least one image is used in the app header/landing area and one as a token/DAO emblem (e.g., icon next to token name).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no additional backend services).

Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files under frontend/src/components/ui; compose them instead.
Authentication must use Internet Identity only.
No external databases or third-party backends.
nonGoals: DEX/liquidity pool integration, listings, or exchange trading features.
Bridging to other chains or wallet integrations beyond Internet Identity.
Advanced DAO features like delegated voting, quadratic voting, or off-chain discussions.
Using or ingesting the referenced ‘iconic video’ content directly (no video hosting or extraction).

required: Memecoin logo illustration of a wooden spoon with playful meme-coin styling, transparent background (wooden-spoon-coin-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Wide banner/hero illustration with a wooden spoon motif, warm wood textures, and meme-like vibe (wooden-spoon-hero.dim_1600x600.png)
Small app icon featuring a simplified wooden spoon emblem, transparent background (wooden-spoon-icon.dim_128x128.png)
